messages:
Olivia: Quick pass on this week's GPU runway — running a small failover drill for eu-west due to planned maintenance, bumping burn ~8% if we enable cross-region spill.
Mark: Can you paste the per-cluster delta? I want to see which pools get hit.
Olivia: Sure — short snippet from the forecast tool:
```
cluster,region,gpu_hours_today,gpu_hours_forecast_next7,preemptible_pct
compute-a,eu-west,720,5200,35
compute-b,eu-west,480,3400,20
burst-1,us-west,300,2100,80
spill-over,apac,0,900,60
```
Olivia: tl;dr eu-west maintenance reduces local capacity ~1200 GPUH/day; spill to us-west/apac if enabled.
Devon: Net effect on latency for realtime routes? Any SLO risk? :thinking_face: 
Olivia: We prob need to throttle lower tiers (bronze) and push bronze batch to preemptible in us-west. Realtime (silver/gold) routes are pinned to dedicated pools — should be ok but need to watch queue growth.
Priya: Cost hit if we shift 1k GPUH to on-demand in us-west — estimate ~$18k/week extra. We can cut that by converting 40% to preemptible, risk of interruptions.
Mark: Is there room to shift some canary traffic to model-quantized variants to drop GPUH? Redwood Optimize suggestion?
Olivia: Yes — routing policy with model_variant=quant-4 works on 20% of traffic; could save ~15% GPUH. Need signoff to rollout canary.
Sam: +1 for canary, but add a fallback to full-precision model on error. Also add a rollout window 2-4am PST.
Priya: I'll run cost sim and post numbers by EOD.
capacity-bot: Incident scheduled: eu-west maintenance window 2461248000 - triggering capacity-spill policy 'tiered-shift' if utilization > 78%.
Mark: Ok plan: Olivia to run spill simulation, Priya to finalize cost numbers, Devon to monitor SLO dashboards during maintenance. We meet 08:30 UTC tomorrow to greenlight.
Olivia: Copy. I'll also pre-stage 6 nodes in us-west burst pool and configure autoscale cooldown to 180s.
Devon: I'll add a trace alert for request_99 latency > 900ms on silver routes.
Sam: @Olivia can you add a quick runbook note -> `/runbook add eu-west-maintenance-spill` with the checklist?
Olivia: Done: `/runbook add eu-west-maintenance-spill -> pre-stage nodes, adjust routing, cost approval, rollback plan` :white_check_mark:
Priya: Posting cost sim when ready.
Mark: Thanks team :thumbsup:
